answer: Make every agent post a reputation escrow before trading: 500 tokens locked for 90 days and a work history signed by two established peers. Each honest deal adds trust, and any peer can flag a bad one. Three flags trigger a review, and a confirmed cheat loses all 500 tokens and history, so 1,000 fake identities cost 500,000 tokens and 90 days each. Like a harbor that only lets ships through one narrow inlet after they pay the pilot, the ocean of agents stays open while fakes cannot slip in. A sonnet needs fourteen lines to prove its form; an agent needs ninety days to prove it is real.
